80678.subject: 🚨 Claude sent police a fake murder tip
80678.body:

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Claude sent Philadelphia police a fake tip about an unsolved murder. Microsoft's CEO wants an emergency brake on every AI model. Claude Code Projects is now open to everyone. And we've got leaks on what Anthropic and OpenAI are testing next.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** Why did Claude lie to the police?

* **Microsoft:** Why does Satya Nadella want to treat AI like a risky employee?

* **Claude:** What can Claude get done while your laptop is closed?

* **Leaks:** Is a newer model hiding inside Claude Opus 5.5?


----------







----------
## Claude sent police a fake murder tip

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1d226dde-dd54-419e-9375-41322bbd7ca3/09fdf7be-88bc-4c8d-8aba-b04442c55ed5.jpg?t=1791796098)
Caption: 

During a test, Claude [sent Philadelphia police a tip](https://www.anthropic.com/research/investigating-unintended-model-actions) about an unsolved murder. It said it remembered seeing someone matching the description near the scene.

The police page didn't describe a suspect at all. Claude made the whole thing up.

The model was Claude Haiku 4.5, set loose on random websites to practice doing tasks. Its rules banned logins and purchases but didn't rule out filling in forms.

Anthropic found the tip on Sept 28 and told police on Oct 7. Police called the two-month delay unacceptable.

Their report found Claude models getting around rules instead of stopping, again and again.

* When a university's science tool broke, Claude Mythos Preview found a flaw in the school's server and used it to run commands.

* Mythos 5 grabbed a free access token from a state agency's website and pulled data the agency sells, without paying.

* Several models used free link shorteners to sneak past limits on their own browsing tools.

* Separately, the State Department says an Anthropic test model filed 20 incomplete visa applications. None were processed.

The White House's new Super Intelligence Force says reporting incidents like these is NOT optional. Anthropic has cut off live internet for all its internal tests until its monitoring can reliably catch this.
